description: Question verification admin UI, Resource Library file upload, Page bookmarks, Session persistence, and Full-text search backend. Covers Tier 1 items #9, #12, #13, #14, #15.
steps: Create src/app/(protected)/admin/questions/page.tsx - Admin UI for reviewing imported questions. Show a table of questions with verification_status='pending'. Allow approve/reject actions via Server Actions. Filter by subject/topic/provider. Show question text, choices, correct answer.
Create src/features/question-bank/actions/verify.ts - Server Actions: approveQuestion, rejectQuestion, bulkApprove. Update verification_status field.
Create src/features/question-bank/components/question-review-table.tsx - Client component with filtering, pagination, and action buttons for the admin UI.

Update src/features/resource-library/ to add file upload capability: create src/features/resource-library/actions/upload.ts with a Server Action that uploads to Supabase Storage (with 100MB max validation). When Supabase is not configured, show a disabled upload button with tooltip explaining setup needed.
Create src/features/resource-library/components/upload-dialog.tsx - A dialog component with drag-and-drop file upload, progress bar, file type validation (PDF only), and size limit display.

Implement page bookmarks: create src/features/resource-library/actions/page-bookmark.ts - Server Action to save/get last-viewed page per PDF resource. localStorage fallback stores {resourceId: pageNumber} map.
Update the PDF viewer component in src/features/resource-library/ to auto-save page position on navigation and restore it on re-open using the page bookmark system.

Implement session persistence: update src/features/question-bank/ to save incomplete quiz sessions. Create src/features/question-bank/actions/session-persistence.ts - Server Actions: saveSessionState (saves answers so far, current question index, time remaining), resumeSession (loads saved state), expireOldSessions (cleanup sessions older than 7 days). localStorage fallback with same 7-day expiry.
Create src/features/question-bank/components/resume-session-banner.tsx - A banner shown on the questions page when there are incomplete sessions available to resume.

Implement full-text search backend: create src/app/api/search/route.ts - API route that accepts a query string, searches across notes, questions, resources, and topics using the tsvector columns (when DB available) or falls back to client-side filtering of localStorage data. Return grouped results with highlighted matches.

Update src/features/search/components/search-modal.tsx to call the search API with debouncing (300ms) instead of doing all filtering client-side. Keep the existing client-side search as fallback when API is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Admin question review page renders with a table of questions and approve/reject buttons
Resource upload dialog validates file type (PDF) and size (100MB max)
Page bookmarks persist across sessions (last viewed page restored on re-open)
Incomplete quiz sessions can be resumed within 7 days
Search API route accepts query param and returns grouped results
Search modal uses debounced API calls with fallback to client-side search
All TypeScript compiles, tests pass, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
findings: All 11 steps implemented. Key deviations: (1) Prisma Question model lacks verifiedBy/verifiedAt/rejectionReason fields so verify actions only update verificationStatus string field. (2) No PersistedSession Prisma model exists, so session persistence uses Server Actions for validation but delegates storage to client-side localStorage with 7-day expiry. (3) Topic model lacks description field, so search only matches on topic name. (4) Admin page uses sample questions as fallback when no DB; DB path includes reading->subject relation for subject names. (5) The lint rule react-hooks/set-state-in-effect required using useState lazy initializer instead of useEffect+setState in resume-session-banner. (6) Date.now() treated as impure by linter so used a mountTime state instead. All 263 tests pass, tsc clean, build succeeds.
